name: dis
note: review: The model mirrors :2466-2592 and the citations are right. DisChecks pins each sanity check from any state with its exact message (probed on 3.15.2: every message as stated), and ReprOk is an honest scope limit (no check fires on float opcodes, PUT/GET ints cannot pass 4300 digits). But no entry states what a successful opcode does: the stack and memo effects (:2534, :2538, :2574-2584) and the printed line are unstated. So a dis that never stores PUTs into the memo, or never pushes stack_after, satisfies DisChecks, DisFollowsGenops and the refutation, while rejecting valid pickles such as b'(lp0ng0na.' or b'N.'. The checks after a MARK pop (b'(Nu.' gives 'tries to pop 1 items from stack with only 0 items') are also outside the pop clause.
